title: Aquarius document analyses Benowitz films and mentions MJ-12
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Aquarius document analyses Benowitz films and mentions MJ-12, about c. 1981 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base / Albuquerque, New Mexico

tellings.quote: he did give him that Aquarius document and it actually mentions access only to MJ12 which is the first time anybody said anything about MJ12 was in this fake document the Aquarius document.

related.note: Both are about the Aquarius document that names MJ-12. Bishop calls it a fake given to Bennewitz, while Davis's source says it was real and that Moore and Doty had nothing to do with it, so only one account can be right.

plain: An author named Greg Bishop says that around 1981, near Kirtland Air Force Base in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a UFO researcher named Bill Moore gave a man named Paul Bennewitz a paper known as the Aquarius document, which discussed films Bennewitz had made. Bishop says the paper mentioned access being limited to "MJ12," the first time anyone had used that name, and he calls the document fake, a story that matters because it would mean Bennewitz was being fed false material.
